page.title: Tips
page.subtitle: Short pointers on estimates, workspace settings, billing, and working with your team.

banner.title: Tips
banner.subtitle: A few pointers to help you get the most out of Esteo.
banner.suggestionHint: Let us know what you need

send_estimate.title: Send a finished estimate directly from Esteo
send_estimate.description: Quickly generate and send professional estimates to clients in one click.

logo_pdf.title: Add your company logo to PDF
logo_pdf.description: Personalize your documents and build brand recognition.

form_website.title: Embed the form on your website
form_website.description: Let clients submit inquiries directly from your website.

upgrade_plan.title: Upgrade to Pro or Business
upgrade_plan.description: Unlock advanced Esteo features — more capacity, team tools, and priority support.

customize_rules.title: Customize rules for your estimates
customize_rules.description: Set your own pricing rules and AI instructions — Esteo applies them on every estimate.

company_description.title: Add your company description
company_description.description: Your company description appears on PDFs and other documents sent to clients.

workspace_transfer.title: You can transfer a workspace
workspace_transfer.description: Transfer workspace ownership to another user when project responsibility changes.

partner_program.title: Partner program (Pro/Business)
partner_program.description: Refer Esteo and earn — the partner program is available on Pro and Business plans.

estimate_modes.title: Basic and advanced estimate modes
estimate_modes.description: In advanced mode you can see margin and get fuller control over line items.

browse_invoices.title: Browse your invoices
browse_invoices.description: Your paid Esteo subscription invoices are available in account settings.

theme_switch.title: Light and dark theme
theme_switch.description: Change how the app looks — pick light or dark mode in workspace settings.

invite_team.title: Invite others to your workspace
invite_team.description: Add team members and work on estimates together in one workspace.

first_estimate_steps.title: Create your first estimate step by step
first_estimate_steps.description: On the Estimates list, click Create estimate, describe the job — AI will prepare the cost breakdown.

voice_create_estimate.title: Say out loud what you're doing
voice_create_estimate.description: In the new estimate form, tap the microphone and describe the job in your own words — e.g. "Bathroom remodel 6 m²".

review_ai_before_send.title: Always review the AI draft
review_ai_before_send.description: AI makes a draft — you decide. Check line items and amounts before sending the PDF to your client.

find_save_pdf.title: Where to find Save as PDF
find_save_pdf.description: Open an estimate → More menu (three dots) → Save as PDF. On your phone you can download the file and share it.

client_sent_inquiry.title: Client sent an inquiry — what now?
client_sent_inquiry.description: Go to Requests, open the client's message and click Create estimate — their details fill in automatically.

share_form_link.title: Send the form link to your client
share_form_link.description: Copy your estimate request link and send it by text, WhatsApp or email — the client describes the job themselves.

preview_client_form.title: See the form as your client sees it
preview_client_form.description: In the sidebar, open Customer acquisition — copy the link or preview the form you share with clients.

fill_company_data.title: Fill in company details before PDF
fill_company_data.description: Company name, tax ID and address appear on PDFs. Esteo reminds you on first export — or go to Settings → Company.

edit_one_line.title: Edit a single line item
edit_one_line.description: Click a line on the list, change the name or amount and save — you don't have to rewrite everything.

ai_chat_plain_language.title: Ask AI in plain language
ai_chat_plain_language.description: In the AI panel, type e.g. "Add 5 outlets" or "Remove ceiling painting" — AI updates the estimate.

payment_deposit.title: Split payment: deposit and balance
payment_deposit.description: In an estimate → Payments tab, add installments — e.g. 30% deposit and the rest on completion.

track_overdue_payments.title: See who hasn't paid yet
track_overdue_payments.description: The Payments tab in the menu shows all installments across your workspace — overdue items on one list.

quick_search.title: Quick search: Ctrl+K
quick_search.description: Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac), type a client name or estimate — find it without clicking through menus.

pin_important_estimate.title: Pin an important estimate in the menu
pin_important_estimate.description: Open an estimate and pin it — get back to it in one click from the left menu without searching the list.

client_photos.title: Photos and files from clients
client_photos.description: Clients can attach photos in the form — you'll see them in Requests and when creating an estimate.

undo_mistake.title: Undo your last change
undo_mistake.description: Made a mistake? Use Undo (Ctrl+Z) in the estimate editor — on the Free plan you get one step back.

what_is_workspace.title: What is a workspace?
what_is_workspace.description: It's your home in Esteo — all estimates, clients and company settings in one place. You can have separate workspaces for different businesses.

use_on_phone.title: Esteo on your phone
use_on_phone.description: Create estimates, dictate by voice and send the link to clients from your phone — handy on site.

report_problem.title: Having trouble? Contact us
report_problem.description: Use Report issue in the menu — describe what's wrong and the Esteo team will help.

pin.maxReached: You can pin up to 3 tips.
